parked.spanish: Hablen a hijos de Israel, diciendo: Esta es la bestia viva que comerán desde todo el animal que sobre la tierra.

findings.issue: «es» is an unmarked supplied copula; זֹאת הַחַיָּה has no verb token.
One definite feminine singular noun is rendered as noun plus adjective; «viva» may add a quality the single noun does not mark separately.

parked.spanish: Solo esto no comerán desde los subientes el cud y desde los partientes la pezuña: el camello, porque subiente cud él, y pezuña no partiente; impuro él a ustedes.

findings.issue: Common noun H1625 is left in English as "cud"; a common noun stays Spanish.
אַיִן has a 3ms suffix (he is not the one parting). Bare "no" drops that person, so "pezuña no partiente" makes the hoof the non-parting participant.
Morphology marks an affirmation particle; "Solo" selects the restrictive sense only.
Hiphil of H5927 is causative (cause the cud to come up). "Subientes/subiente" is the simple participle of subir; causation is only implicit in the object.

parked.spanish: Y estas abominarán desde el ave; no serán comidos, abominación ellos: el nesher y el peres y la ozniah,

findings.issue: את marks אלה as object and תשקצו is piel imperfect 2mp; Spanish makes estas the subject of abominarán, so the addressees no longer act and these become a third party.
Common nouns are left as untranslated lemmas nesher, peres, and ozniah.
findings.spanishSpan: el nesher y el peres y la ozniah

parked.spanish: y el kos y el shalaj y el yanshuf,

findings.issue: Common nouns (definite singular) are left as untranslated Hebrew-shaped words instead of Spanish common nouns.
findings.spanishSpan: kos y el shalaj y el yanshuf

findings.issue: Each וְאֶת contributes ו as y; the direct-object marker is not lexicalized. Grammatical smoothing with no added participant or concept.

parked.spanish: Y cuando muriere desde el animal que ella a ustedes a comida, el tocante en su cadáver se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: Unmarked “se” is Spanish middle voice on the qal imperfect; it smooths “become unclean” without a reflexive participant.
“desde” can mean source or cause; מִן before the definite animal also allows partitive “from among.”

parked.spanish: No abominarán sus almas en todo el reptil el reptante, y no se impurificarán en ellos, y se impurificarán en ellos.

findings.issue: Piel jussive 2mp has the addressees acting on נפשותיכם (את object). «No abominarán sus almas» makes the souls the subject that abominates.
H8318 is one swarming/creeping creature; «reptil» narrows it to the reptile class.
Qal participle of H8317 (swarm/teem) is rendered as crawling («reptante»).

Hithpael 2mp and niphal sequential perfect 2mp are both «se impurificarán», flattening self-defilement and the resulting unclean state. If «sus almas» stays subject, those 2mp addressees also become the souls.
